color.note: Stone, not screen. Dark is basalt and slate; light is limestone. One accent, oxidised bronze, desaturated so it never pops. Nothing in the palette is saturated above a brass inlay. Dark is the primary theme.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background: the desktop. Basalt in dark, limestone in light, both with the grain overlay. ink, ink-2, ink-3, accent-text, positive and negative all read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised stone: Work windows, the contact card, Now items, the Spotify strip. Grain on. Same text tokens as ground.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Second step: window title bars, inputs, code blocks, media frames. Also the opaque fallback fill for frosted slate where backdrop-filter is unsupported.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, window edges, the taskbar fallback border. Decorative by design (under 3:1); never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: input borders, the QR frame, player scrub tracks, the far particles. 3:1 or better on ground, surface and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: the hero name, titles, body, the <SM/> mark, the signature stroke. Limestone on basalt in dark, basalt on limestone in light. 11:1 or better on all three grounds.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: the hero fact line, Now bodies, dates, window subtitles, the near particles. 5.3:1 or better on all three grounds in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, timestamps, disabled labels. 4.5:1 or better on all grounds in both themes; keep it at 14px or larger.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Oxidised bronze: the one hue, used as a fill only. The primary CTA, the solved cube's front face, the player's progress fill, the lens ring. Text on it is on-accent. For text or thin strokes use accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Bronze as text or a thin stroke on ground, surface or surface-2: links, the live particles, the active taskbar label, the playhead. 6.7:1 or better in dark, 5.7:1 or better in light.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent fills, both themes (4.8:1 or better). Never white on bronze.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Form sent, vCard saved. Sage, muted; always arrives with a word. 4.7:1 or better on all grounds in both themes.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Validation errors, failed send. Terracotta, muted; always arrives with a word. 4.6:1 or better on all grounds in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every surface. On an accent fill the ring switches to on-accent.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind an open Work window on mobile and behind the skip-boot dialog.

tokens.name: frost-tint
tokens.usage: The fill of frosted slate (taskbar, pill, lens): surface at 72% over the blur, so what shows through is dimmed stone, not a white sheen. Always with frost-blur behind it and grain on top.

tokens.name: frost-border
tokens.usage: The 1px outer edge of frosted slate. Decorative.

tokens.name: frost-edge
tokens.usage: A hairline along the top inside edge of frosted slate, drawn as an inset shadow (see shadow-frost). A cut edge, not a specular highlight: it never exceeds 10% white in dark.

tokens.name: field-near
tokens.usage: Near particles of the cosmos field at rest.

tokens.name: field-far
tokens.usage: Far particles of the cosmos field; depth is lightness, never size alone.

tokens.name: field-live
tokens.usage: Particles while audio plays and within 64px of the cursor.

tokens.name: cube-white
tokens.usage: Cube face, boot only. A matte stone cube: every face is desaturated to the level of the palette. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: cube-yellow
tokens.usage: Cube face, boot only.

tokens.name: cube-red
tokens.usage: Cube face, boot only.

tokens.name: cube-orange
tokens.usage: Cube face, boot only. The front face when solved; it carries <SM/> in on-accent and is what the camera pushes into, so it is the accent.

tokens.name: cube-blue
tokens.usage: Cube face, boot only.

tokens.name: cube-green
tokens.usage: Cube face, boot only.

families.mono: "Geist Mono Variable", "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display — Bricolage Grotesque
groups.note: Pairing A, re-tuned quiet. Weight 300 at hero size and 400 for titles: at light weights and large optical size the face reads engraved rather than mischievous. Never above 500 anywhere.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The hero name only. 52px at 375 wide.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Section titles (Now, Work, About, Play, Contact) and Work window titles. This is the text that docks into the top bar when scrolled past.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Case-study sub-sections, the contact card name.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Now item titles, media captions that lead.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Software engineer. 5+ years in TypeScript, React and Node, mostly on healthcare systems.
styles.usage: The hero fact line, case-study lede, the About paragraph. Max measure 60ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Built a parallax stage with one ScrollTrigger timeline per fold; route JS stayed under 250 KB gzipped.
styles.usage: Everything that is read. Max measure 65ch.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, form hints, window subtitles, the Spotify strip's track line. ink-2.

styles.name: taskbar
styles.usage: Taskbar item labels. 13px at 375 wide. The focused label switches to accent-text and is magnified by the lens, not by a font-size change.

styles.name: mark
styles.usage: The wordmark as the taskbar Home item. The boot face sets it in the same face at 1/3 of the cube face width.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, dates, the docked section title's prefix, the loader's percent readout and the player's time (tabular-nums).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and the signature-detail snippet in a Work window.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Steps are the only vertical rhythm; components never carry their own margins, the layout places them with gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, the lens ring inset, hairline offsets, cube sticker gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and taskbar items (vertical), between a label and its value, the scrub track height.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Taskbar item horizontal padding, input padding, between a Now title and its body.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and window inner padding at 375, the mobile side gutter, between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Window inner padding at 1440, between CTAs, the field's clearance around the name.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section, the Work window title bar height, the horizontal-scroll gutter between windows.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: The taskbar height at rest, section inner top padding at 375.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section inner top padding at 1440; the desktop side gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections where no fold runs; hero top offset below the taskbar.

radius.note: Three sizes and a pill. Windows are lg, controls are md, small frames are sm. Stone is cut, not moulded: nothing larger than lg except the pill and the lens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, the QR frame, code blocks, cube stickers, the player's scrub thumb.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, media blocks, Now items, the Spotify strip.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Work windows, the contact card, the taskbar in its resting bar state, the About render's frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The taskbar in its scrolled pill state, taskbar items, the lens (a circle when square).

shadow.note: Stone casts soft, low shadows: large blur, low opacity, no hard edge. Frosted slate adds a hairline cut edge. No shadow is used for emphasis.

tokens.name: shadow-frost
tokens.usage: Every frosted-slate element: the taskbar, the pill, the lens. The inset line is frost-edge; keep both parts together.

tokens.name: shadow-stone
tokens.usage: Work windows, the contact card, the About render frame. The ring is line; the drop is wide and faint so the slab reads as resting on the ground, not floating.

tokens.name: shadow-pill
tokens.usage: The taskbar once it has shrunk to a floating pill.

material.note: The stone finish. One grain texture (SVG feTurbulence, tiled) at low opacity over every ground and surface, in blend mode overlay. The same grain goes over frosted slate so glass and stone read as one quarry.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the grain layer on ground and surface. 0.05 on surface-2 in light where limestone shows more texture. Never above 0.06: grain must be felt, not seen.

tokens.name: grain-tile
tokens.usage: The tile size of the grain texture. Fixed in CSS px so it does not scale with the element and never looks like a pattern.

tokens.name: grain-frequency
tokens.usage: feTurbulence baseFrequency for the tile (fractalNoise, 2 octaves). Lower reads as marble veining, which this is not.

tokens.name: frost-blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur radius for the taskbar, pill and lens. 14px at 375 wide to stay inside the GPU budget.

tokens.name: frost-saturate
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter saturate, barely above neutral: slate dims what is behind it rather than enriching it.

tokens.name: lens-magnify
tokens.usage: The scale the lens applies to the focused taskbar item and the sampled backdrop. Applied with transform, never font-size.

tokens.name: lens-displace
tokens.usage: feDisplacementMap scale in the lens filter (Chromium only). Lower than a glass lens would use: slate bends light less. Zero where unsupported.

tokens.name: lens-size
tokens.usage: The lens diameter in the resting bar; 36px in the pill and on mobile. Its ring is 1px in frost-edge, and accent-text while the item is pressed.

duration.note: Three durations. Every transition on the site uses one of them. Boot is the single exception: its length is real asset loading.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press states, colour changes, the cursor dot following the pointer, particles recolouring near the cursor.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: The lens travelling between taskbar items, focus ring movement, a section title docking into the bar, theme switch, form validation messages appearing, the Spotify strip updating.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: The taskbar morphing to a pill and back, a Work window opening, the <SM/> dissolve into the hero, route view transitions, the field settling after playback stops.

easing.note: Two curves. standard for anything that arrives and stays; spring for anything the visitor pushes (the lens, hold-and-drag, the pill, the render).

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Decelerating. Opacity, colour, docking, window open, fold frames, route transitions. Pairs with duration-base and duration-slow.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Slight overshoot (about 6%). The lens landing on an item, the pill morph, the hold-and-drag release, the About render returning to rest after a drag. Never on opacity, never on text.

z-index.note: The OS stack, bottom to top. Nothing sits between layers without a token.

tokens.name: z-field
tokens.usage: The cosmos field canvas, fixed behind everything.

tokens.name: z-desktop
tokens.usage: Hero text, sections, the About render, the signature.

tokens.name: z-window
tokens.usage: An open Work window.

tokens.name: z-taskbar
tokens.usage: The taskbar and the docked section title inside it.

tokens.name: z-lens
tokens.usage: The lens, which rides above the bar it magnifies.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: The scrim behind a mobile window or the skip dialog.

tokens.name: z-boot
tokens.usage: The boot sequence. Removed from the DOM when done.

tokens.name: z-cursor
tokens.usage: The custom cursor, if kept after the M0 try-and-decide.
